description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LegoSets" name="Lego brick sets"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SortedContainers" name="Sorted parts in containers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LegoMachine">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder"
                      name="Machine builder"
                      processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Children"
                      name="Group of children"
                      processRef="Process_Children"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GiveSets"
                      name="Give Lego sets to children"
                      sourceRef="Task_GiveSets"
                      targetRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                      messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnSortedContainers"
                      name="Return sorted containers"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder"
                name="Build a custom machine out of Lego bricks"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Builder" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveSets"
                   name="Give Lego sets to the children"
                   messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      name="Receive sorted parts in containers"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"
                     name="Build and test a subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Subcomponent" name="Start subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                             name="Are there parts remaining in a container?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent"
                 name="Build the subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult"
                             name="Was the subcomponent test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"
                 name="Redesign the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SubcomponentTestSuccessful"
                     name="Subcomponent test successful"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1"
                         sourceRef="Start_Subcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                         targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInAContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                         targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInAContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4"
                         sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts"
                         targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5"
                         sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6"
                         sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                         targetRef="End_SubcomponentTestSuccessful">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                         targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testUnsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9"
                         sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"
                           name="Are there more subcomponents to build?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"
               name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1"
                       sourceRef="Start_Builder"
                       targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2"
                       sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign"
                       targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3"
                       sourceRef="Task_OrderSets"
                       targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4"
                       sourceRef="Task_GiveSets"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                       targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6"
                       sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"
                       targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"
                       targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noMoreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9"
                       sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"
                       targetRef="End_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Children"
                name="Sort Lego parts into containers"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSets" name="Lego sets received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSets"
                                   messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort the parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReturnSorted"
                   name="Return sorted containers"
                   messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Children" name="Sorted containers returned"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1"
                       sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                       targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2"
                       sourceRef="Task_SortParts"
                       targetRef="Task_ReturnSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted"
                       targetRef="End_Children"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
